description: Use this when the user asks whether a travel eSIM is cheaper or better than their own mobile carrier's international roaming pass or plan for a trip to one destination, or about local SIM cards. Compares the carrier's published pass price with the eSIM plans in the OsmO catalogue. For multi-country trips, call it once per country.
name: compare_roaming_vs_esim
title: Compare roaming pass vs eSIM
